title: 开发商、贷款人与投资者的共同预期
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium wide shot around a contemporary boardroom table. Three East Asian professionals, a property developer, a bank credit officer and a private investor, review one ordinary office project model, a valuation folder and a financial forecast. Each points to a different document and nods. The same set of assumptions is being shared across the table.
